game.title: Ultima II: The Revenge of the Enchantress (DOS)

shots.caption: Intro text: ORIGIN PROUDLY PRESENTS
Intro text: Part II of the #1 best selling fantasy role-playing game
Title picture: Ultima II, the dragon, Revenge of the Enchantress
Main menu: D demonstration, P play a game, C create a new character
Demo: battle strange creatures across the face of the Earth
Demo: search for clues at the local pub (Swashbucklers Pub and Pizza)
Demo: traverse deep dark deadly dungeons and tall terrifying towers
Demo: travel throughout the galaxy to the planets of our solar system
Demo: conquer time itself to battle Minax the Enchantress
Player generation: 90 points to distribute, Strength asked first
Six statistics typed (25 20 15 10 10 10): no points left
Male chosen: Strength 25 -> 30
Human chosen: Intelligence 10 -> 15
Fighter (Strength +15), name RYZ: SATISFACTORY (Y/N)
Another build: female elf wizard (Charisma +10, Agility +5, Int. +10)
ryz in the woods of 1423 B.C.: H.P. 400, food 399, gold 400
Ztats of the new ryz: level 0 male human fighter, hands, skin
North, east, then SOUTH--INVALID MOVE! at the water's edge
Enter a sign: THE SIGN READS: ANOS: 1423 B.C.
Q: QUIT OR SAVE GAME. ONE MOMENT PLEASE! (play goes on)
Commands with nothing to act on: BOARD WHAT? HYPER WHAT? LAUNCH WHAT?
More refusals: GET WHAT? FIRE WHAT? X-IT WHAT?
DESCEND-WHAT? KLIMB-WHAT? (ladders only below ground), VIEW WHAT?
Cast: NEED WAND OR STAFF!; Negate time: YOU'RE NOT EINSTEIN
Unlock: NO DOOR THERE!; Transact with nobody: FUNNY, NO RESPONSE!
Offer gold: OFFER TO WHOM?; Steal north: NO LUCK!
Jump: JUMP...WHEE...; Ignite torch on the surface does nothing
Magic: MAGIC SPELL READY #1 -> SPELL READY => LIGHT
Ready weapon: 1-DA .. 9-QU list; 5 (sword): NOT OWNED!
Wear armour: 1-CLOTH .. 6-POWER; 4 (plate): NOT OWNED!
Yell: YELL WHAT? HELLO (the word is echoed, nothing answers)
The village of 1423 B.C.: ryz at the south gate, villagers about
Grendel the Bum says: Masters of riddle are masters indeed!
Robert Woodhead exclaims: Copy protect! Copy protect!
The chaste nubile nymph asks: Visit the Hotel California?
Alfreds Fish n Chips: THE FOOD HERE COSTS 0052 PER 100, WANT ONE?
Yes: NO ONIONS AND TO GO PLEASE! Food 399 -> 499, gold 400 -> 348
Holy Spells to a fighter: RYZ YOU ARE NOT A CLERIC!
Holy Spells to a cleric: WELCOME BROTHER RYZ, six spells, YOUR INTEREST?
FIVE LIGHTS FOR 0020, YES, FRIEND? Yes: I WILL TAKE 5!
Wizardry to a fighter: RYZ YOU ARE NOT A WIZARD!
Wizardry to a wizard: RYZ MUSERREF OLDUM! Six spells, BIR IKI UC...?
Five passwalls for 356 gold: LUTFEN EVET? YES - GULE GULE! (gold 44)
The oracle: TIME AND TRAVEL MADE ME WISE... HOW MUCH WILL YOU PAY *100?
Pay nothing: ASK ME NO QUESTIONS, I'LL TELL YOU NO LIES.
100 gold: THE QUEEN IS THE KING AND THE KING IS A SPY.
300 gold: BUT DISPELLING MEANS THAT YOU MUST HAVE THE RING.
700 gold: THERE IS AN OLD MAN LIVING UNDER A TREE.
900 asked of a poorer ryz: YOU DONT HAVE THAT MUCH!
Towne Linda (1423 B.C.): the gate with the towne's name in the wall
The Weapons Shoppe: 1-DA .. 8-PH (dagger to phaser), YOUR INTEREST?
5: AH! YES! A SWORD FOR YOU ONLY 0136 HOW 'BOUT IT?
A light sword for 356: SOLD! (gold 400 -> 44)
A mace declined: HOW 'BOUT IT? N - OH, WELL.
A phaser asked with 400 gold: YOU DONT HAVE THAT MUCH!
The Armoury: 1-CLOTH .. 6-POWER, YOUR INTEREST?
Chain mail for 220 gold: SOLD! (gold 400 -> 180)
Pub de Varg: WELCOME TO THE PUB! 1-BUY, 2-TIP
1-Buy (5 gold), and THE BARKEEP SAYS: ISN'T THIS A GREAT GAME?
A tip of 5 gold: THE BARKEEP SAYS: AVIATORS USE SKULL KEYS!
A tip of 9 gold: THE BARKEEP SAYS: ANKHS OPEN SPACE!
Transport shoppe: I SELL YOU HORSE 0084 GOLD, DEAL, OK?
Deal: RIDE SWIFTLY! The horse waits in the shop (gold 316)
Ithilian the Wench calls: Make me an offer sailor!
John Mayer orders: TAKE OUT THE TRASH!!!
Keith says: No thanks, trying to cut down.
Lord British's castle (1423 B.C.): the pillared hall below the throne
Lord British: FIRST MY 50 G.P. TRIBUTE! AND FOR IT I RAISE THEE 0300
Brother Antos ordains: Search the stars for my kin!
Bishop Bob preaches: Confess to Brother Antos!
The wandering bard asks: Do you know the way to San Jose?
A GUARD SAYS: PAY YOUR TAXES! (gate of Towne Linda)
A MERCHANT SAYS: WILL YOU BUY MY APPLES?
A JESTER SINGS: HO HO HO!
A FIGHTER SAYS: UGH, ME TOUGH!
A CLERIC SAYS: BELIEVE!
A WIZARD SAYS: HEX-E-POO-HEX-ON-YOU!
A THIEF SAYS: PSST, WANNA BUY A WATCH?
The 1423 B.C. dungeon without a torch: IT'S DARK! (nothing drawn)
Torch lit: wireframe corridor east, the ladder up overhead (level 1)
TURN LEFT: a side corridor, the ladder still overhead
TURN RIGHT, then RETREAT-BLOCKED! (a wall behind)
A doorway ahead in a dungeon corridor
A chest on the floor at the end of the corridor
Get on the chest square: GET CHEST! IT CONTAINS GOLD! (gold +7)
D on a ladder down: DESCEND TO LEVEL 01 (levels count from 00)
K on the ladder of the top level: KLIMB back out to the surface
Dungeon creature of the first kind two squares ahead (upper levels)
A creature of the third kind (middle levels)
A creature of the fifth kind
A creature of the seventh kind, the deepest
ATTACK--HIT! on the creature ahead; it strikes back (H.P. 3184 -> 3181)
KILLED--GOLD+11--EXP.+00: the creature is gone
ARGH! A TRAP! ESCAPED! BY USE OF TOOLS! (torch out: IT'S DARK!)
A trap without tools: RYZ IS DEAD! (all numbers zero, the game stops)
Level 16 (0F) of the dungeon: chests in the north-west rooms
A chest on level 16: IT CONTAINS TRI-LITHIUM! (rocket fuel)
With a wand: MAGIC 1, CAST-LIGHT lights the dark dungeon
CAST-PASSWALL: the wall ahead is gone, a new passage opens
CAST-MAGIC MISSILE at a creature: KILLED--GOLD+11--EXP.+06
CAST-PRAYER: the creature ahead is KILLED (gold +17)
CAST-DOWN LADDER: TO LEVEL 01 without a ladder
CAST-SURFACE on tower level 4: straight back out by the tower
Inside the tower of 1423 B.C.: corridor south, the ladder down out
Towers go up: KLIMB TO LEVEL 01 from a ladder up
Ztats of a level 20 ryz: light sword, reflect armour, items, 6 tri-lithium
Status panel of the late ryz: H.P. 3184, food, experience 2083 (level 20), gold
Ready weapon 5: SWORD READY.
Wear armour 3: CHAIN READY.
A new ryz readies a light sword: THOU ART NOT AGILE ENOUGH TO WIELD!
Power armour on a weak ryz (Str 25): THOU ART NOT STRONG ENOUGH TO WEAR!
View with the magical helm: VIEW WITH MAGICAL HELM! The whole Earth
Negate time with a strange coin: YOU RUB A COIN... (monsters stop)
Unlock west with a key: a jail cell door in Lord British's castle opens
The same door without keys: NO KEYS THAT FIT!
A thief steals across the weapons counter: STEAL WEAPONS!
100 gold offered to a guard: THANK YOU VERY MUCH! (nothing in return)
Seven kinds of land monsters close in on ryz in the woods
A devil steps out of the woods beside ryz
ATTACK--WEST--HIT!!! KILLED--GOLD+03--EXP.+04
After the kill, a second blow at the empty square: ATTACK--WEST--MISS
LEGS PARALIZED! SAVED BY MAGICAL BOOTS! (a paralyser two squares away)
ARMS PARALIZED! SAVED BY MAGICAL CLOAK (the hooded figure)
A wizard's MAGIC MISSILE! H.P. 3184 -> 3070
A daemon's SLEEP SPELL! SAVED BY IDOL!
A thief beside ryz: A THIEF STOLE SOMETHING!
A time door (barred gate) has wandered next to ryz in 1423 B.C.
Through the door: the walled islet of the Time of Legends, with its sign
THE SIGN READS: ANOS: LEGENDS!
Pangea, 9,000,000 B.C.: one supercontinent of grass, woods and hills
THE SIGN READS: ANOS: 9,000,000 B.C.
The same sign square in 1990: ANOS: 1990 A.D.
And in the Aftermath: ANOS: 2112 A.D.
The village of Pangea, guarded gate
In Pangea an astronaut claims: There is a planet 'X'!
Another astronaut claims: Father Antos lives on 'X'
The Phylosopher theorizes: She's GOT to be at 9-9-9!
Port Bonifice, the village of 1990 A.D.
The Sightless Sage says: Find the Father Earn the Ring!
Lord British in 1990: 50 gold buys +300 H.P. even at 3184 (3484 now)
Brother Antos in 1990 inquires: Have you found my father?
The subdued balron whimpers: Lithium packs the 16th level!
The merchant orders: Give the King a tribute!
2112 A.D.: Pirates Harbour, the village of the Aftermath
CCCP TEST LAUNCH: three rockets on their pads and the control house
The Village Idiot suggests: Offer the hotel clerc gold!
Red the Pirate boasts: I've a broken Ultima ]I[, want one?
On the water: a sea serpent and a pirate frigate beside ryz
New San Antonio's stable: BOARD HORSE
Riding the horse west through the 1423 B.C. woods
Pirates Cove: BOARD FRIGATE (ryz carries a blue tassle)
No blue tassle: THE CREW OF THIS SHIP WILL NOT LET YOU BOARD!
Under sail on the 1423 B.C. sea
Cannons: FIRE DIRECT-EAST, a miss, then the serpent KILLED
A frigate cannot go ashore: WEST--INVALID MOVE!
The airfield of Pirates Harbour: BOARD PLANE (skull key)
Without a skull key: STRANGE YOU CAN'T GET IN!
Launch without a brass button: FUNNY THIS PLANE IS MISSING A BRASS BUTTON!
LAUNCH--PLANE: flying over the 2112 coast, steered SOUTH then WEST
L over hills: LAND--NOT HERE!!!!! (planes land on grass only)
L over grass: LAND PLANE.
Board a rocket: A METALIC VOICE COMMANDS: YOU MUST HAVE AN ANKH!
New San Antonio (1990 A.D.): the towne gate
In the jail: Santre the Swashbuckler warns: Beware, I've a quick blade!
500 gold offered to Santre: ENILNO IS YOURS! (the quicksword)
Ready 9 with Agility 71: QUICK SWORD READY.
Under A TREE: An old man mumbles: I'm an old man.
500 gold to the old man before the blessing: EARN THE RING! (gold kept)
At Own Risk: The Flopy Fighter brags: I own one of everything!
100 gold to the Flopy Fighter: HERE TAKE THIS! (a phaser this time)
The Hotel: A clerk states: Welcome to the Hotel California!
200 gold to the clerk: ALAKAZAM! (Agility 71 -> 79; rare, 6 in 256)
CCCP Test Launch: BOARD ROCKET (ankh, reflect armour, tri-lithium)
No tri-lithium: A METALLIC VOICE SAYS: SHIP INCAPABLE OF LAUNCH!
Launched in chain mail: YOU HAVE EXPLODED! (the game ends)
Launch: the star tunnel of HYPERWARP ENGAGED! up to orbit
YOU ARE ORBITING EARTH. Panel: FUEL, XENO, YAKO, ZABO
Space controls: CLIMB (also LEFT, RIGHT, DIVE) shift the star field
H: HYPERWARP TO: XENO=9 YAKO=9 ZABO=9, PREPARE FOR HYPERWARP!
HYPERWARP ENGAGED! the star tunnel on the way to 9-9-9
YOU ARE ORBITING X. (planet X at 9-9-9, fuel 4)
1-1-1: YOU ARE IN DEEP SPACE.; landing: REQUEST DENIED!
4-4-4: YOU HIT THE SUN! (the game ends)
Three tri-lithium left after a jump: SHIP OFF COURSE! (7-1-1)
H with no tri-lithium: NO FUEL!
L in orbit: LANDING REQUESTED! The rocket drifts over X (PRESS ANY KEY)
Landed on X: the rocket on grass beside Ozys Place
Ozys Place, the castle of planet X
Father Antos: You have earned my blessing. Return and claim the Ring!
Castle Barataria: Queen Susan says: Father Antos awaits you!
Ozys Place kitchen: Sing Lee the cook yells: Kichen clost, com bac lato!
Towne Basro, the towne of planet X
Towne Basro: Ugly Irving states: No mages allowed!
An experienced warrior says: Find Antos, earn the Ring!
Mercury (5-4-5): landed in a crater ring, its dungeon nearby
Venus (3-3-4): marshes and seas, no place to enter
Mars (6-2-3): mountains, the rocket beside Towne Mary
Towne Mary on Mars
Towne Mary: Marlin Perkins threatens: Go in and I'll zap you!
Jupiter (1-3-4): the village, a tower and a dungeon in the woods
Jupiter's village: The Jocker laughs: You're half way there!
Saturn (2-8-5): woods and water, nothing to enter
Uranus (9-4-6): the village New Jester among the woods
New Jester, the village of Uranus, jesters at the gate
Neptune (4-0-5): grass everywhere, a lake by the village
Computer Camp, the village of Neptune
Computer Camp: Richard Garriott promises: Tomorrow--for sure!
Pluto (0-1-4): mountains and woods, the rocket beside Towne Marler
Towne Marler on Pluto
Adams Pub: The Seaworthy Pirate says: See the clerk in New San.
Towne Marler: The Big Bouncer stalls: Where the hell is your I.D.?
Back to Earth: landings always end in 2112 A.D., ryz beside the rocket
With the blessing the old man takes 500 gold: THE RING IS YOURS!
Legends: Shadow Guard in its ring of mountains, an army of monsters outside
Shadow Guard: the gate behind a force field (magenta bars)
North through the field with the ring: RING PROTECTS FROM FIELD!
Without the ring: FIELD CAUSES 1000 DAMAGE! twice (H.P. 3184 -> 1184)
Inside Shadow Guard: a hall with a horse, a frigate, a plane and a rocket
The Morgue: Homer the Salesman asks: Ya want some life insurance?
Chamber One: Minax beside ryz, two winged guardians: MINAX CRIES: DIE FOOL!
Minax: A coward dies a thousand deaths, a hero only one... you lose!!!
A quicksword hit (255 -> 213 H.P.): SHE'S GONE!!! Then SAVED BY IDOL!
Chamber Two: Minax beside ryz again, MINAX CRIES: DIE FOOL!
Seven quicksword hits later: MINAX IS DEAD!! ALL HER WORKS SHALL DIE!
ALL HER WORKS SHALL DIE: Shadow Guard breaks apart square by square
YOU HAVE SAVED THE UNIVERSE, AND COMPLETED ULTIMA ][! ... rocket over 1990
